title: 第19章 周韬的疑心第20章 十楼山脉
lines: “啊，这，那这小子是挺不是男人的”
，张长青张了张嘴，最后只能如此道。
这种情况下就亲了张天雪一口，事后更是害怕的跑掉了，怎么想张天雪好像都不亏。
毕竟换了一条命。
年轻人还是有些把握不住啊。
周韬眯着眼睛，这理由听着像那么回事，但似乎也不像那么回事。
“那他有说要去哪里吗？”
周韬问道。
张天雪虽然不知道这里是哪里，但东南西北还是分得清的，回忆了一下之前林辰离开的方向便道：“他也没说清楚，就说会去南边，有事情要办。”
张天雪并不担心这么说会导致林辰被周韬找到。
她这两天已经看出来了，林辰这家伙谨慎小心的很，根本就不信任她，怎么可能在她面前朝着要去的方向走？
一定会中途改道的。
哼，讨人厌的家伙！
周韬点点头，随即道：“张小姐若是不介意，不知是否可以提供一下此人的画像，顺便，将此人的战斗方式、习惯都详细的说一遍。”
张天雪皱了皱眉，“大人问这么详细做什么，难道他是什么犯人吗？”
“那倒不是，只是想了解一下”
，禁卫呵呵一笑。
“可我现在很累了”
，张天雪并不愿意。
张长青见此，连忙道：“统领大人，雪儿这两日经历了太多，的确是身心俱疲，还请让她休息一下，略作调整再问话。”
只是闻言，周韬淡淡的扫了张长青一眼，什么都没说。
张长青顿时脸色一变，眼底有些怒意，却不敢发作出来，最后只能对着张天雪温声道：“雪儿，要不你先回答大人的问题吧，大人为陛下办事，想必很着急。”
如此，张天雪只能点点头。
她开始描述。
面对周韬她不敢轻易撒谎，因为很多山贼还活着，一旦对照起来很容易露出破绽，反而会让林辰处于险地。
所以张天雪选择照实说，但在关键信息上，会说得模糊。
这并不会被怀疑，毕竟那么紧急的情况她不可能什么都记得清楚，但导致的结果，却可能与真相大相径庭。
包括画像也是八分真两分假，这谁也说不出什么问题来。
周韬也没有说什么，问完之后便告辞离去。
“雪儿，我们也尽快回去吧，你爷爷他，唉……”
张长青长叹一声。
这次是因为老爷子病危，张天雪他们才会急着走那条官道的。
可现在张长利反而先老爷子一步离世，实在令人唏嘘。
“爷爷他怎么样了！”
张天雪顿时急了起来，眼睛发红。
张老爷子向来最为疼爱她，这次她冒险也是为了尽快赶回去。
“父亲这次怕是很难挺过去了，虽然也请来了大魏最好的药师，但也只是吊住老爷子性命”
，张长青叹了口气。
而如果张老爷子故去，那么对于九鼎商会的打击将非常巨大！
九鼎商会能够有现在的规模，张老爷子的人脉、威望、手段，缺一不可。
而一旦张老爷子去世，九鼎商会必定无法震慑那些竞争对手。
甚至连皇室都在眼热九鼎商会的庞大财力！
所以九鼎商会不论付出什么代价都想要保住老爷子的性命，只要老爷子还在，九鼎商会就没有人敢动！
content_en:
"Ah, this, then this boy is not a man."
, Zhang Changqing opened his mouth, and finally could only say this.
In this case, I kissed Zhang Tianxue, and ran away in fear afterwards. No matter how I thought about it, Zhang Tianxue seemed to be at a loss.
After all, a life has been changed.
Young people are still a little unsure.
Zhou Tao squinted his eyes. This reason sounded like that, but it didn't seem like that.
"Then did he say where he was going?"
Zhou Tao asked.
Although Zhang Tianxue didn't know where this place was, he could still distinguish the southeast from the northwest. He recalled the direction Lin Chen left before and said, "He didn't make it clear. He just said he would go to the south because he had something to do."
Zhang Tianxue was not worried that saying this would lead to Lin Chen being found by Zhou Tao.
She had already seen it in the past two days. Lin Chen was very cautious and didn't trust her at all. How could he walk in the direction he wanted to go in front of her?
It will definitely be diverted midway.
Huh, annoying guy!
Zhou Tao nodded and then said: "If Miss Zhang doesn't mind, I wonder if you can provide me with this person's portrait. By the way, I can also tell you in detail about this person's fighting methods and habits."
Zhang Tianxue frowned, "My lord, why are you asking in such detail? Is he some kind of prisoner?"
"That's not true, I just want to know more."
, the imperial guard chuckled.
"But I'm very tired now"
, Zhang Tianxue was not willing.
Seeing this, Zhang Changqing hurriedly said: "Your Majesty, Xueer has experienced too much in the past two days. She is indeed exhausted both physically and mentally. Please let her rest and adjust a little before asking questions."
Just hearing this, Zhou Tao glanced at Zhang Changqing lightly and said nothing.
Zhang Changqing's expression suddenly changed, and there was some anger in his eyes, but he did not dare to express it. In the end, he could only say warmly to Zhang Tianxue: "Xue'er, why don't you answer your question first? Your Majesty must be in a hurry to do something for you."
In this case, Zhang Tianxue could only nod.
She began to describe.
She didn't dare to lie easily to Zhou Tao, because many bandits were still alive. Once compared, it would be easy to reveal flaws, which would put Lin Chen in danger.
So Zhang Tianxue chose to tell the truth, but he would be vague about the key information.
This will not be suspected. After all, it is impossible for her to remember everything clearly in such an emergency situation, but the result may be completely different from the truth.
Even the portraits are 80% true and 20% false. No one can tell what the problem is.
Zhou Tao didn't say anything, and left after asking.
"Xue'er, let's go back as soon as possible. Your grandfather, ugh..."
Zhang Changqing sighed.
This time it was because the old man was critically ill that Zhang Tianxue and the others were in a hurry to take the official route.
But now Zhang Changli has passed away before the old man, which is really sad.
"Grandpa, how is he?"
Zhang Tianxue suddenly became anxious and his eyes turned red.
Mr. Zhang has always loved her the most, and this time she took the risk to get back as soon as possible.
"I'm afraid it will be difficult for my father to survive this time. Although he invited the best pharmacist from Wei Dynasty, he was only hanging on to the old man's life."
, Zhang Changqing sighed.
And if Mr. Zhang dies, the blow to the Jiuding Chamber of Commerce will be huge!
For the Jiuding Chamber of Commerce to reach its current scale, Mr. Zhang’s connections, prestige, and means are indispensable.
And once Mr. Zhang dies, the Jiuding Chamber of Commerce will definitely not be able to deter those competitors.
Even the royal family is eyeing the Jiuding Chamber of Commerce's huge financial resources!
Therefore, the Jiuding Chamber of Commerce wants to save the old man's life no matter what the cost. As long as the old man is still there, no one in the Jiuding Chamber of Commerce will dare to touch him!
